D.t: George Latimer leads by 49.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 124,661 votes; a one point swing is about 1,256 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +42.5 and D +56.5. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
